name: Anima Squad BGM - Swarm
creator: matthewchasm
description:
A scuffed Anima Squad bgm using Summoner's Rift Updated Theme Music. To use, go to settings > sounds (under in-game tab if on client) > set Summoner's Rift Theme Music to Updated (scroll to bottom). Compatible and best complimented with the Anima Squad rift mod. Featuring music from Riot's Anima Squad 2024 Swarm event.
